text:
dario: heads up — saw a 20-30% p99 latency regression on Mixtral MoE serving in staging after the kernel-selection reorder. router logs show increased logit sparsity and more reroutes.

anya: can you paste the short perf summary?

dario: quick summary from profiler: router_dispatch spiking, KV cache miss rate up ~3x, GPU kernel queueing increased. attaching top-line.

perf-bot: PROFILE SNAPSHOT: gpu_util=98% | router_dispatch=42% | kv_cache_lookup=18% | kernel_gpu_softfill=15% | batching_wait=11%

kai: hmm — router_dispatch up implies more expert handoffs. did top_k or routing policy change in the last deploy?

dario: we A/B'd quality: top_k bumped 8 -> 12 and enabled prefer_lcm batching (more mixed-size packing). also kernel policy changed to "latency_prefer" on some nodes.

jess: top_k increase would amplify expert churn and cause more KV misses + cache pressure. batching packing can amplify head-of-line stalls if router wait increases.

sam: quick mitigation to try: revert top_k to 8, set expert_parallelism=2 (more parallel dispatch to experts), and flip on kv_prefetch in runtime to reduce lookup stalls.

anya: config snippet to try:
```json
{"runtime":{"top_k":8,"expert_parallelism":2,"kv_prefetch":true,"kernel_policy":"latency_prefer"}}
```

kai: also run a controlled microbench: `bench/mixtral_moe --seq=128 --batch=16 --policy=latency_prefer` and capture `nvprof` + our tracing `moe_tracer` to see expert handshake latencies.

dario: running bench now on staging fleet node-07. quick profiler line after config change: `router_dispatch avg 1.9ms -> 1.2ms`, kv_cache_miss_rate 3.1% -> 1.0%.

jess: good sign. also check RoPE interactions — on some head/kv dim combos we hit a memcpy path in kernel selector that bumps latency (observed on 4/8 head split).

sam: add `rope_scale=0.5` to the test matrix and ensure kernel selector picks `fp16_vec4` path rather than the scalar fallback. that avoided memcpy in previous runs.

dario: notes from run: best p99 improvement when (top_k=8, expert_parallelism=2, kv_prefetch=true, rope_scale=0.5). throughput steady. planning to run 3x repeat and longer tail test with seq 64/128/512.

anya: :thumbsup: great. capture config + perf in the perf doc and tag me if p99 stays >10% regress vs baseline.

perf-bot: deploy started by @dario at 1998884480

dario: deploy finished on canary nodes — immediate post-deploy p99 delta: +2% vs baseline (was +25% before mitigations). follow-up: need long-tail stress under bursty arrival patterns and validate kernel selection across heterogenous GPUs.

kai: next steps: 1) run bursty arrival sim (poisson lambda sweep), 2) add `kv_eviction_threshold` telemetry, 3) validate router softfill backpressure heuristics under expert imbalance.

jess: also add a small tracer in the kernel selector to log chosen kernel id + reason when we hit scalar fallback. helps root-cause RoPE/heads dimension regressions.

sam: I'll add the kv_prefetch flag to runtime flags and a guarded rollout. if p99 stable after 24h, promote to broader canary.

anya: thanks all — great quick loop. we'll sync tomorrow with bench graphs and nvprof traces.
